title: Identity verification
intro: Prove who you are with a government ID and a quick selfie. People who run events and places on Abonten verify, so that when something goes wrong, such as a fraud report or an emergency at an event, Abonten knows who is responsible.
requiredFor: {purpose, select, payouts {You need a verified identity to receive payouts.} place_claims {You need a verified identity before a place you claimed can be handed to you.} verified_badges {You need a verified identity to get a Verified badge.} paid_events {You need a verified identity to sell tickets.} other {You need a verified identity.}}
verifiedNote: Only you see these details. Others on Abonten see an “ID checked” badge next to your name.
checkingBody: We'll tell you as soon as it's done. You can leave this page.
unfinishedBody: Continue on the secure page to take the photos, or cancel and start again.
cancelBody: You can start again whenever you like.
reviewTitle: Someone at Abonten is checking your documents
reviewBody: We'll tell you when it's done.
outcome: {code, select, document_expired {Your document has expired. Use one that is still valid.} document_unreadable {We couldn't read your document. Try again in good light, with the whole document in the frame.} document_not_genuine {Your document didn't pass the security checks.} face_mismatch {Your selfie didn't match the photo on your document.} selfie_not_live {We couldn't confirm the selfie was taken live. Try again in good light, without filters.} underage {You must be {age} or older to verify.} duplicate {This document is already linked to another Abonten account. Contact Abonten Support.} provider_error {Something went wrong at our verification partner. Please try again.} not_finished {The check wasn't finished in time. Start again.} other {If you think this is a mistake, contact Abonten Support.}}
expiredBody: Your document expired, or it has been a while since you verified. Verify again to keep your badge.
documentName: {type, select, GHANA_CARD {Ghana Card} PASSPORT {Passport} DRIVERS_LICENSE {Driver's licence} VOTER_ID {Voter ID card} NATIONAL_ID {National ID card} other {Other government ID}}
step1: You'll go to the secure page of our verification partner, Smile ID.
step2: Take a photo of your document and a short selfie.
step3: Come back here. We'll tell you the result.
whatWeKeep: Abonten keeps the name and date of birth on your document, the last four characters of its number and when it expires. Your photos stay with Smile ID: Abonten never stores them.
whoSees: Nobody else on Abonten sees your details. Abonten staff see them only to settle a problem, and every look is recorded.
consent: I agree that Abonten and Smile ID check my document and selfie to confirm who I am.
noAttemptsLeft: You've tried several times today. Try again tomorrow.
couldNotStart: Couldn't start the check. Please try again.
networkError: Couldn't reach Abonten. Check your connection and try again.
notAvailableYet: Identity verification isn't available on your account yet.
returnedBody: If you finished on the secure page, we're checking your documents now.
testIntro: This page stands in for the verification partner on test sites. Pick the result it should send.
testOutcome: {outcome, select, clear {Clear: verified} attention {Needs a look} block {Blocked: face doesn't match} error {Error: couldn't read the photos} underage {Clear, but under age} other {Other}}
testDone: Done. The result has been sent.
doneTitle: You've finished on the secure page
doneBody: Go back to the Abonten app to see your result. We'll also let you know when we've finished checking.
